Every workshop topic pairs **1:1:1:1** across four layers: a slide-deck **lecture**, a long-form **book chapter** (under [Readings](Readings.qmd)), a laptop **tutorial** (on `ifnb`, under [Tutorials](Tutorials.qmd)), and — for the core analysis steps — the matching **Talapas HPC script** that runs the *same* `ifnb` workflow as a SLURM batch job. The laptop teaches the concept interactively; the Talapas script runs the identical analysis on the cluster. Use this page as your one-stop index to all of it.

::: callout-note
**How the Talapas track lines up.** Each Talapas analysis **R script is numbered to match its laptop tutorial** — `01_qc_preprocessing.R` parallels Tutorial 01, and so on through script 08 — all on the **same `ifnb` dataset**, no raw FASTQs required. Start with **[Talapas 01](Exercise_Folder/Talapas/Tutorial_Talapas_01_SLURM_Basics.html)** (SLURM basics), then the [Talapas 03 — Analysis Pipeline](Exercise_Folder/Talapas/Tutorial_Talapas_03_Analysis_Pipeline.html) page ties the scripts together. Scripts `01`–`08` form the core pipeline; the bonus tutorials (scATAC, WGCNA, Spatial, Trajectory, FAIR) each have a matching standalone script `09`–`13`. To run the whole pipeline from **raw FASTQs** on a real 10x dataset instead, see [Additional Resources → Full Talapas RNA-seq run from raw FASTQs](Additional_Resources.qmd).
:::
